title: Obstructive and Central Sleep Apnea Treatment
excerpt: Keeps the title block, Coverage Rationale through the converter-merged table row that also holds the Medical Records Documentation Used for Reviews text, Applicable Codes, and the opening of Clinical Evidence as a distractor, and drops the Definitions entries after that row.
candidate_deviations: Sets auth_type to prior_authorization although the excerpt never states a prior authorization requirement.
